input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including token detail impl, user detail impl, user, request login user. The platform provides capabilities for entry point unauthorized handler, my access denied handler, login. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage token detail impl records, so that I can track and organize token detail impl data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user detail impl records, so that I can track and organize user detail impl data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage request login user records, so that I can track and organize request login user data effectively.
